result.description: Paygent-branded payment gateway (hint: NMI-powered); a Connect product for marketplace payments, split payments and vendor onboarding is claimed on gopaygent.com. Vendor docs could not be verified.
result.auth_detail: Unverified. The gopaygent.com homepage sample reportedly sends a Bearer key with a pgt_live_ prefix. If the product is NMI-based, auth would be an NMI security key (private API key). I could not read the docs.
result.access_detail: Unverified. I could not read signup or pricing pages. If NMI-powered, working keys normally need a merchant gateway account, which a reseller or ISO provisions and underwrites. Connect marketplace payouts probably need onboarding or approval.
result.api_notes: Search snippets say gopaygent.com offers REST APIs, with documentation, an API Reference and webhooks linked from the homepage. A /v1/payments endpoint and payment intents appear in the sample. The docs hostnames did not resolve or render, because the sites are JavaScript apps. Breadth is a guess. If the product is NMI-based, the NMI Payment API and v4 REST API cover payments, vault, recurring and reporting. The Japanese Paygent Co. is an unrelated company.
result.blocker: Product identity and docs are ambiguous. Several unrelated companies use the Paygent name. gopaygent.com and pay-gent.com render only their titles through fetch, so no developer docs were readable. The NMI link is unconfirmed. Contact the vendor to get docs and sandbox keys before building.
